entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with Special G.R. Case No.105 of 2022 pending on the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Balangir, arising out of Muribahal P.S. Case No.184 of 2022for commission of offence alleged under Sections 457/ 380/ 363/ 366/
376(2)(n)/ 120B/ 34 of IPC read with Sec.6 of POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.
4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Spl Judge (POCSO), Balangir in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. This Court by order dated 03.07.2023 in BLAPL No.5140 of 2023, considering the statement of the victim under Section 164 of IPC rejected the bail application of the Petitioner.

Admittedly,
though the trial has commenced, victim has not been examined.
6. This Court again carefully perused the 164 Cr.P.C statements of the victim, since there is no change in circumstance, this Court is not inclined to entertain the bail application at this stage.

sentences.text: 1 7. Liberty is granted to the Petitioner to renew his prayer before the learned Court in seisin after examination of the victim.
8. Learned counsel for the State is called upon to ensure the presence of witnesses on the date fixed.
Copy of this order be made over to the learned counsel for the State to do the needful.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per the rules.
